def max_tandem_repeat(s, k):
    n = len(s)
    extended_string = s + s[:k]
    max_length = 0
    
    for length in range(1, n + k // 2 + 1):
        found = False
        for start in range(n):
            end = start + length * 2
            if end > len(extended_string):
                break
            if extended_string[start:start + length] == extended_string[end - length:end]:
                max_length = length * 2
                found = True
                break
        if found:
            break
    
    return max_length
